description: Canonical CWE -> OWASP Top 10:2025 (web) pairing source-of-truth for the CWE/A##:2025 tag-pair validator (scripts/validate-schemas.sh, step [8/8]). The `canonical` table is a 1:1 CWE->A## map derived verbatim from lib/owasp-web-top10.md Part 1 (the CWE -> A##:2025 lookup table). `context_overrides` lists deliberate, documented (cwe, owasp, cat) triples that intentionally differ from `canonical` (context roll-ups) OR carry a CWE that is absent from the canonical web-Top-10 table; these MUST NOT be flagged as mismaps. A pair that is neither a canonical match nor a listed override is a genuine tag-mismap and fails validation. Keep `canonical` in sync with owasp-web-top10.md if that table changes.
source_of_truth: skills/security-audit/lib/owasp-web-top10.md (Part 1 — OWASP Top 10:2025 web, CWE -> A##:2025 lookup table)

context_overrides.why: Code Injection via a poisoned CI/build step (e.g. GitHub Actions discussion.body injection) is a software-supply-chain failure in cat-10's context, so it rolls up to A03 (Software Supply Chain Failures) rather than its generic canonical bucket A05 (Injection). owasp-web-top10.md notes a finding can legitimately roll up to A03 even when its category is supply_chain.

Hard-coded credentials in CI/CD pipeline config (CICD-SEC-6 Insufficient Credential Hygiene) is a supply-chain/build-infrastructure failure in cat-10's context, so it rolls up to A03 (Software Supply Chain Failures) rather than its generic canonical bucket A07 (Authentication Failures).

Execution with Unnecessary Privileges (privileged container, SYS_ADMIN capability, docker.sock mount) is a hardening/Security-Misconfiguration concern. CWE-250 is intentionally absent from the canonical OWASP web-Top-10 lookup table, so cat-07 maps it to the closest applicable category A02 (Security Misconfiguration). Documented here so the absent-from-canonical WARN path does not fire and the pairing is treated as a vetted, deliberate choice.

Insufficient Granularity of Access Control is the precise CWE for the collection-scoping class: a gate EXISTS and authenticates the caller, but rows are not constrained to that caller. It is Broken Access Control (A01) at the collection level (OWASP API1:2023 BOLA + API3:2023). CWE-1220 is absent from the canonical web-Top-10 lookup table, so this override documents the intended roll-up instead of leaving a permanent WARN.

Exposure of Private Personal Information to an Unauthorized Actor — used when the unscoped collection returns PII columns rather than mere identifiers. Still an access-control failure (A01), not a logging/monitoring one; the disclosure is the consequence, the missing row-scope is the defect.
